[{"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 48, "h": 14, "i": "p1"}, "panelIndex": "p1", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Dell Device Overview", "markdown": "## Dell Infrastructure — Device Overview

Filter: `device.vendor: dell` on data view `metrics-snmp.device-*` (or `metrics-*`).

**Devices in scope**

| Device | Role | Site | IP range |
|--------|------|------|----------|
| dell-srv-01, dell-srv-02 | server | prod | 10.10.5.x |
| dell-srv-dr-01 | server | dr | 10.20.5.x |
| dell-sw-prod-01 | switch | prod | 10.10.0.x |
| dell-storage-01 | storage | prod | 10.10.6.x |

**Discover query to see all Dell SNMP docs (last 24 h):**
```
GET /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{
  "size": 10,
  "query": {"bool": {"filter": [
    {"term": {"device.vendor": "dell"}},
    {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-24h"}}}
  ]}}
}
```
", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "hidePanelTitles": false, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 14, "w": 48, "h": 14, "i": "p2"}, "panelIndex": "p2", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Dell Interface Traffic", "markdown": "## Interface Traffic Fields

Key counter fields (cumulative octets):

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifInOctets.1` | eth1 bytes received |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifOutOctets.1` | eth1 bytes sent |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifOperStatus.1` | 1=up, 2=down |

Interfaces .2 through .8 follow the same pattern.

**Traffic query (last 1 h, Dell devices):**
```
POST /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{"size":5,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"term":{"device.vendor":"dell"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}]}},"sort":[{"snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifInOctets.1":"desc"}]}
```
", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "hidePanelTitles": false, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 28, "w": 48, "h": 18, "i": "p3"}, "panelIndex": "p3", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Dell Storage & Health", "markdown": "## Storage & System Health Fields

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.host.hrStorage.hrStorageTable.hrStorageEntry.hrStorageSize.1` | Total storage (512-byte blocks) |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.host.hrStorage.hrStorageTable.hrStorageEntry.hrStorageUsed.1` | Used storage |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.system.sysUpTime.sysUpTimeInstance` | Uptime (hundredths of a second) |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.system.sysDescr.0` | System description |
| `device.name` | Device hostname |

**PSU failure scenario (dell.psu_failure):** Power draw shifts; look for `ifOperStatus` = 2 on uplink interface.
**Memory leak scenario (dell.mem_leak):** `hrStorageUsed.1` climbs in a sawtooth — peaks then resets every ~3 h.
**Capacity breach scenario (dell.capacity_breach):** `hrStorageUsed.1`/`hrStorageSize.1` ratio crosses 0.85.

**Capacity ratio query:**
```
POST /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{"size":0,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"term":{"device.vendor":"dell"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}]}},"aggs":{"devices":{"terms":{"field":"device.name"},"aggs":{"max_used":{"max":{"field":"snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.host.hrStorage.hrStorageTable.hrStorageEntry.hrStorageUsed.1"}},"max_size":{"max":{"field":"snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.host.hrStorage.hrStorageTable.hrStorageEntry.hrStorageSize.1"}}}}}}
```
", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "hidePanelTitles": false, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 46, "w": 48, "h": 10, "i": "p4"}, "panelIndex": "p4", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Dell Scenario Schedule", "markdown": "## Dell Scenarios (every ~3 h ± 45 min)

| Scenario ID | Duration | What happens | Field to watch |
|-------------|----------|--------------|----------------|
| `dell.psu_failure` | ~30 min | PSU status + power draw shift | `ifOperStatus.1` on uplink + `sysUpTime` |
| `dell.mem_leak` | ~3 h window | `hrStorageUsed.1` climbs sawtooth-style then resets | `hrStorageUsed.1` trend |
| `dell.capacity_breach` | ~45 min | Storage usage crosses 85% then recovers | `hrStorageUsed.1`/`hrStorageSize.1` ratio |

Scenario values are deterministic from `(t, GLOBAL_SEED)` — backfill and live data match exactly.
See `docs/scenarios/dell.md` for full schedule documentation.
